issues.failure_explanation: The set \VV_\ell^+ includes old vertices in \VV_\ell \cap \VV_{\ell-1} whose patch changed, so \XX_\ell^+ contains hat functions associated with old vertices. Its dimension is #\VV_\ell^+ (excluding boundary), which is larger than the codimension of \XX_{\ell-1}^1 in \XX_\ell^1 (which is #(\VV_\ell \setminus \VV_{\ell-1})). Hence the sum cannot be direct.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Remove the direct sum claim or redefine \XX_\ell^+ to be the span of new hat functions only, while keeping \VV_\ell^+ for local solves.
issues.overall_effect: The stated space decomposition is incorrect. The algorithms use \VV_\ell^+ for local corrections, so the main results may not depend on this direct sum, but the claim is false as written.
issues.title: False direct sum of finite element spaces
issues.why_classification: A short local correction of the space definition or removal of the false claim preserves all algorithmic and theoretical results.

issues.failure_explanation: Proposition \ref{lemma: MG contraction} applies to Algorithm \ref{algo: geometric MG} with its optimal step-sizes \lambda_{\ell'}. The linearized variant replaces these with a fixed \lambda=(d+1)^{-1}. No proof is given that this variant contracts, nor that it shares the same q. Since optimal step-sizes minimize the energy error, a fixed step-size can yield a different (larger) contraction factor.

issues.failure_explanation: For \ell'=\ell, the product is empty, so \vec{B}^{\downarrow}_\ell = \vec{I}^+_\ell (\vec{D}^+_\ell)^{-1} (\vec{I}^+_\ell)^T. But \vec{D}^+_\ell is an N_\ell^p \times N_\ell^p matrix while \vec{I}^+_\ell is N_\ell^p \times N_\ell^+, making the product dimensionally inconsistent. The high-order correction on the finest level should be $(\vec{D}^+_\ell)^{-1}$ without the \vec{I}^+_\ell factors. Moreover, for \ell'<\ell the product range \prod_{i=\ell}^{\ell'-1} is empty for \ell'=\ell-1, so the down corrections miss the pre-smoothing factors. Similarly, the coarse solve uses A_0^{-1}, but \vec{D}_0^+ is set to \lambda \vec{A}. Thus the definition of \vec{B}^{\SMG}_\ell is ill-defined/incorrect.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the matrix formulas for \vec{B}^{\downarrow} and \vec{B}^{\uparrow} to match Algorithm \ref{algo: symmetric MG}, then rederive the representation in \eqref{eq: symmetric multigrid preconditioned matrix}.
issues.overall_effect: Corollary \ref{corollary: symmetric MG optimality} is about an ill-defined/incorrect preconditioner; its proof and SPD/optimality claims are invalid as stated.
issues.title: Incorrect matrix representation of symmetric multigrid preconditioner
